comparison.objective: Hold a cord taut and cut it with a knife away from the holding hand.
comparison.physical_skill: Bimanual tensioning, edged-tool control, guarded cutting, and safe placement.
comparison.success_condition: Cord severed at safe distances while held; blade never contacts robot or table; knife released on the table and nothing lost. Cord tension has no numeric threshold.
comparison.reason: Tensioned cutting and blade safety do not overlap meaningfully with aperture-based media recovery.
